fields.status: Windows and Linux builds are available in the parent repository’s v1 release (published 2026-08-11); its release assets are desktop archives only, with no Android APK. The maintainer documents the Android ARMv7 SDL2 build as working but experimental, requires Android API 36 / armeabi-v7a, and names no tested physical device. The parent repository’s latest push was 2026-08-15.
